records.literal_gloss: A miktam of David. Keep me, God, for I have taken refuge in you.

en.L: A miktam of David. Keep me, God, for I have taken refuge in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: A miktam of David. Guard me, God, for I have made {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} my refuge.
en.R: A song of David. Watch over me, God. I come to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for safety.

fr.L: Un miktam de David. Garde-moi, Dieu, car je me suis réfugié en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: Un miktam de David. Protège-moi, Dieu, car j’ai fait de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} mon refuge.
fr.R: Un chant de David. Veille sur moi, Dieu. Je viens me mettre à l’abri auprès de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Mikitamu ya Daudi. Unilinde, Ee Mungu, kwa maana nimekimbilia {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.
sw.B: Mikitamu ya Daudi. Unihifadhi, Ee Mungu, kwa maana nimekufanya {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} kuwa kimbilio langu.
sw.R: Wimbo wa Daudi. Uniangalie, Mungu. Ninakuja {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} ili nipate usalama.

es.L: Mictam de David. Guárdame, oh Dios, porque en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} me he refugiado.
es.B: Mictam de David. Protégeme, oh Dios, porque he hecho de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} mi refugio.
es.R: Canto de David. Cuídame, Dios. Vengo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} para estar a salvo.

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: miktam: a kind of psalm whose meaning is unknown
decisions.reason: The word (miktam) stands at the head of this psalm and of Psalms 56-60. Its meaning is lost; the ancient Greek translation took it as an inscription on a stone, and others link it to a word for gold.

decisions.choice: I have taken refuge: I have run to God for shelter
decisions.reason: As in 7:2 and 11:1.

decisions.choice: A song
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (m2); Readable says only that it is a song.

decisions.choice: "miktam" kept as a name (Literal, Balanced); "Un chant" at Readable
decisions.reason: The kind of psalm the word names is unknown (m2), so French keeps it as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Mikitamu" kept as a name at Literal and Balanced; "Wimbo" at Readable
decisions.reason: What a miktam was is not known (m2). The word is kept in a Swahili form, as the English keeps it; Readable says only that it is a song.

decisions.choice: Mictam
decisions.reason: The Hebrew miktam names a kind of psalm whose meaning is no longer known. Literal and Balanced keep the word in its Spanish form, "mictam"; Readable says "Canto", as the English Readable says "A song".

source.text: אָמַ֣רְתְּ לַֽ֭יהוָה אֲדֹנָ֣י אָ֑תָּה ט֝וֹבָתִ֗י בַּל־עָלֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: You have said to YHWH, My Lord [are] you; my good [is] not beyond you.

en.L: [My soul,] you have said to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "You [are] my Lord; my good [is] not beyond {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."
en.B: My soul, you have told {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "You are my Lord; my good is found in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} alone."
en.R: My soul, you told {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "You are my Lord. All the good I have is {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."

fr.L: [Mon âme,] tu as dit {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Tu [es] mon Seigneur ; mon bonheur n’[est] pas en dehors de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. »
fr.B: Mon âme, tu as dit {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Tu es mon Seigneur ; mon bonheur, je ne le trouve qu’en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. »
fr.R: Mon âme, tu as dit {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Tu es mon Seigneur. Tout le bien que j’ai, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. »

sw.L: [Ee nafsi yangu,] umemwambia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Wewe [ni] Bwana wangu; mema yangu hayapo nje {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}."
sw.B: Nafsi yangu, umemwambia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Wewe ni Bwana wangu; mema yangu yanapatikana {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} peke yako."
sw.R: Nafsi yangu, ulimwambia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Wewe ni Bwana wangu. Mema yote niliyo nayo ni {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}."

es.L: [Alma mía,] has dicho {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «Tú [eres] mi Señor; mi bien no [está] fuera de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}».
es.B: Alma mía, le has dicho {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «Tú eres mi Señor; mi bien se encuentra solo en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}».
es.R: Alma mía, le dijiste {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «Tú eres mi Señor. Todo el bien que tengo eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}».

decisions.choice: you have said: the psalmist speaking to himself
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text has "you (feminine) have said", most naturally spoken to the psalmist's own soul, a word that is feminine (as in 42:6). The ancient Greek and other early translations read "I have said". Either way, the words are the psalmist's own confession.

decisions.choice: my Lord: my master
decisions.reason: The title ('Adonai) is used of God as master; the psalmist calls himself his servant.

decisions.choice: my good is not beyond you: I have no good apart from you
alternatives: my good does not rest on you
decisions.reason: The short phrase most likely means that every good the psalmist has is in God alone.

decisions.choice: My soul
decisions.reason: The feminine "you" is addressed to the soul (m1); Literal brackets the words, and Balanced and Readable say them so that the reader knows who is spoken to.

records.literal_gloss: As for [the] holy ones who [are] in the land, they and [the] majestic ones, all my delight [is] in them.

en.L: As for the holy ones who [are] in the land, they [are] the majestic ones; all my delight [is] in them.
en.B: The holy people who live in the land are the truly great; they are my whole delight.
en.R: God's people who live in this land are the ones I admire. They make me very happy.

fr.L: Quant aux saints qui [sont] dans le pays, ils [sont] les nobles ; tout mon plaisir [est] en eux.
fr.B: Les fidèles qui vivent dans le pays sont les vrais grands ; ils font toute ma joie.
fr.R: Le peuple de Dieu qui vit dans ce pays, voilà les gens que j’admire. Ils me rendent très heureux.

sw.L: Kwa habari ya watakatifu walio katika nchi, wao [ndio] watukufu; furaha yangu yote [iko] kwao.
sw.B: Watu watakatifu wanaoishi katika nchi ndio wakuu kweli; wao ndio furaha yangu yote.
sw.R: Watu wa Mungu wanaoishi katika nchi hii ndio ninaowaheshimu. Wananifurahisha sana.

es.L: En cuanto a los santos que [están] en la tierra, ellos [son] los nobles; todo mi deleite [está] en ellos.
es.B: Los santos que viven en la tierra son los verdaderamente grandes; ellos son todo mi deleite.
es.R: El pueblo de Dios que vive en esta tierra es la gente que admiro. Me hacen muy feliz.

decisions.choice: the holy ones: God's faithful people
alternatives: the holy ones of the land: other gods, whom the psalmist once delighted in or now renounces
decisions.reason: The verse is very hard to construe; the words do not fit together smoothly. Read with verse 2, it says that God's faithful people are the ones the psalmist delights in. Read with verse 4, "the holy ones in the land" and "the mighty ones" may be the gods of the land, which the psalmist turns away from. The first reading is followed.

decisions.choice: the majestic ones: the noble, the truly great
decisions.reason: The word ('addir) is used of nobles and leaders (Judges 5:13), and of the LORD's own majesty (8:2).

decisions.choice: God's people
decisions.reason: Readable says who the holy ones are on the reading followed (m1).

source.text: יִרְבּ֥וּ עַצְּבוֹתָם֮ אַחֵ֪ר מָ֫הָ֥רוּ בַּל־אַסִּ֣יךְ נִסְכֵּיהֶ֣ם מִדָּ֑ם וּֽבַל־אֶשָּׂ֥א אֶת־שְׁ֝מוֹתָ֗ם עַל־שְׂפָתָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Many [are] their sorrows, another they have acquired; not I will pour out their drink offerings of blood, and not I will take their names on my lips.

en.L: Their sorrows will multiply [who] have acquired another [god]; I will not pour out their drink offerings of blood, and I will not take their names on my lips.
en.B: Those who court another god will have sorrow upon sorrow. I will not pour out their offerings of blood, or even speak the names of their gods.
en.R: People who chase after other gods will have more and more trouble. I will not join in their offerings of blood. I will not even say the names of their gods.

fr.L: Leurs douleurs se multiplieront, [à ceux qui] ont acquis un autre [dieu] ; je ne verserai pas leurs libations de sang, et je ne prendrai pas leurs noms sur mes lèvres.
fr.B: Ceux qui courtisent un autre dieu auront douleur sur douleur. Je ne verserai pas leurs offrandes de sang, et je ne prononcerai même pas le nom de leurs dieux.
fr.R: Les gens qui courent après d’autres dieux auront de plus en plus de malheurs. Je ne participerai pas à leurs offrandes de sang. Je ne dirai même pas le nom de leurs dieux.

sw.L: Huzuni zao zitaongezeka [wale] waliojipatia [mungu] mwingine; sitamimina sadaka zao za kinywaji za damu, wala sitayataja majina yao midomoni mwangu.
sw.B: Wale wanaomfuata mungu mwingine watapata huzuni juu ya huzuni. Sitamimina sadaka zao za damu, wala sitataja hata majina ya miungu yao.
sw.R: Watu wanaofuata miungu mingine watapata taabu zaidi na zaidi. Sitashiriki katika sadaka zao za damu. Sitataja hata majina ya miungu yao.

es.L: Se multiplicarán los dolores [de los que] han adquirido otro [dios]; no derramaré sus libaciones de sangre, ni tomaré sus nombres en mis labios.
es.B: Los que cortejan a otro dios tendrán dolor sobre dolor. No derramaré sus ofrendas de sangre, ni siquiera pronunciaré los nombres de sus dioses.
es.R: La gente que corre detrás de otros dioses tendrá cada vez más problemas. No participaré en sus ofrendas de sangre. Ni siquiera diré los nombres de sus dioses.

decisions.choice: acquired another god: taken another god as their own
decisions.reason: The verb (mahar) is used of paying a bride-price to win a wife (Exodus 22); here it pictures people wooing another god. Others read a related verb meaning to hurry after. "God" is not in the Hebrew but is implied by the drink offerings and names that follow.

decisions.choice: drink offerings of blood: offerings to other gods
decisions.reason: Drink offerings were poured out in worship (Numbers 15:5). Offerings of blood may be a pagan rite, or offerings brought by violent people; either way, the psalmist will have no part in them.

decisions.choice: take their names on my lips: speak their names in worship
decisions.reason: Israel was told not even to mention the names of other gods (Exodus 23:13).

decisions.choice: the names of their gods
decisions.reason: "Their names" are the names of the other gods (m1), as Exodus 23:13 shows; Balanced and Readable say so.

source.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה מְנָת־חֶלְקִ֥י וְכוֹסִ֑י אַ֝תָּ֗ה תּוֹמִ֥יךְ גּוֹרָלִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH [is the] portion of my share and my cup; you [are] holding my lot.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] the portion of my share and my cup; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} [are] holding my lot.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is the share I have been given and the cup I drink; it is {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} who hold my lot secure.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is all I have and all I need, like a share of land or a cup to drink from. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} keep safe everything that is mine.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] la portion de ma part et ma coupe ; {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tiens mon lot.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est la part qui m’est donnée et la coupe que je bois ; c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui gardes mon lot en sûreté.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est tout ce que j’ai et tout ce dont j’ai besoin, comme une part de terre ou une coupe où boire. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gardes en sécurité tout ce qui est à moi.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] fungu la sehemu yangu na kikombe changu; {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} [ndiwe] unayeshika kura yangu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye sehemu niliyopewa na kikombe ninachokinywea; ni {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unayeilinda kura yangu iwe salama.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye kila kitu nilicho nacho na kila ninachohitaji, kama shamba la urithi au kikombe cha kunywea. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unalinda salama kila kilicho changu.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] la parte de mi lote y mi copa; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [estás] sosteniendo mi suerte.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es la parte que me ha tocado y la copa que bebo; eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quien mantiene segura mi suerte.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es todo lo que tengo y todo lo que necesito, como una parcela de tierra o una copa para beber. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} guardas a salvo todo lo que es mío.

decisions.choice: the portion of my share: like the Levites, whose share was the LORD
decisions.reason: When Israel received the land, the Levites were given no land, for "I am your portion and your share", the LORD said (Numbers 18:20; Deuteronomy 10:9). The psalmist says the LORD himself is his share.

decisions.choice: my cup: what I am given
decisions.reason: A person's cup is the lot God gives, of blessing (23:5) or of judgment (11:6).

decisions.choice: you hold my lot: my future is safe with you
decisions.reason: Land was shared out by lot (Joshua 18:6-10); the psalmist's lot, what life has given him, is held firm by God.

decisions.choice: all I have and all I need, like a share of land or a cup to drink from
alternatives: the portion of my share and my cup
decisions.reason: Readable explains the pictures of the share of land and the cup (m1, m2).

source.text: חֲבָלִ֣ים נָֽפְלוּ־לִ֭י בַּנְּעִמִ֑ים אַף־נַ֝חֲלָ֗ת שָֽׁפְרָ֥ה עָלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] lines have fallen for me in pleasant [places]; indeed, [the] inheritance is beautiful to me.

en.L: [The] lines have fallen for me in pleasant [places]; indeed, the inheritance is beautiful to me.
en.B: The measuring lines have marked out a lovely place for me; truly, the land I inherit delights me.
en.R: What God has given me is wonderful, like a beautiful piece of land. I love what I have received.

fr.L: [Les] cordeaux sont tombés pour moi en [des lieux] agréables ; oui, l’héritage est beau pour moi.
fr.B: Les cordeaux d’arpenteur m’ont tracé un lieu charmant ; vraiment, la terre dont j’hérite me ravit.
fr.R: Ce que Dieu m’a donné est merveilleux, comme un beau terrain. J’aime ce que j’ai reçu.

sw.L: Kamba za kupimia zimeniangukia mahali pazuri; naam, urithi huo ni mzuri kwangu.
sw.B: Kamba za kupimia zimenipimia mahali pa kupendeza; kweli, nchi ninayoirithi inanifurahisha.
sw.R: Kile ambacho Mungu amenipa ni kizuri ajabu, kama kipande cha ardhi kilicho kizuri. Ninapenda kile nilichopokea.

es.L: [Las] cuerdas de medir han caído para mí en [lugares] agradables; sí, la herencia es hermosa para mí.
es.B: Los cordeles de medir me han señalado un lugar precioso; de verdad, la tierra que heredo me llena de alegría.
es.R: Lo que Dios me ha dado es maravilloso, como un hermoso terreno. Me encanta lo que he recibido.

decisions.choice: the lines have fallen: the measuring lines that mark out land
decisions.reason: Measuring lines marked out each family's land (Joshua 17:5; Micah 2:5). The psalmist's share, the LORD himself (verse 5), is a lovely place.

decisions.choice: inheritance: the share passed on in a family
decisions.reason: The word (nachalah) is a family's land handed down; here it is a picture of what God has given the psalmist.

decisions.choice: What God has given me
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture and names the giver (m1).

source.text: אֲבָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת־יְ֭הוָה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְעָצָ֑נִי אַף־לֵ֝יל֗וֹת יִסְּר֥וּנִי כִלְיוֹתָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: I will bless YHWH who has counseled me; also [in the] nights my kidneys have instructed me.

en.L: I will bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who has counseled me; also [in the] nights my kidneys instruct me.
en.B: I bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, my adviser; even at night my deepest self keeps teaching me.
en.R: I praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shows me what to do. Even at night, deep inside, I learn what is right.

fr.L: Je bénirai {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui m’a conseillé ; même [les] nuits mes reins m’instruisent.
fr.B: Je bénis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, mon conseiller ; même la nuit, le fond de mon être continue de m’enseigner.
fr.R: Je loue {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me montre ce que je dois faire. Même la nuit, au fond de moi, j’apprends ce qui est juste.

sw.L: Nitambariki {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambaye amenishauri; hata usiku figo zangu zinanifundisha.
sw.B: Ninambariki {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mshauri wangu; hata usiku ndani kabisa ya nafsi yangu ninaendelea kufundishwa.
sw.R: Ninamsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sababu ananionyesha la kufanya. Hata usiku, ndani ya moyo wangu, ninajifunza yaliyo sahihi.

es.L: Bendeciré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, que me ha aconsejado; aun [en las] noches mis riñones me instruyen.
es.B: Bendigo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, mi consejero; aun de noche lo más profundo de mi ser me sigue enseñando.
es.R: Alabo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me muestra qué hacer. Aun de noche, en lo más profundo de mi ser, aprendo lo que es correcto.

decisions.choice: my kidneys: my inmost self
decisions.reason: The kidneys stand for the hidden depths of a person, the feelings and conscience (7:10; Jeremiah 17:10). The LORD's counsel works there, even in the night.

decisions.choice: bless the LORD: praise him
decisions.reason: When people bless God they praise him and give him thanks.

decisions.choice: nights: night after night
decisions.reason: The plural means that it happens night after night.

decisions.choice: "kumbariki BWANA" for blessing God (L, B); "kumsifu" (praise) at Readable, as the English Readable
decisions.reason: When people bless God they praise and thank him (m2). Swahili can use the same verb, "kubariki", for God blessing people and people blessing God, which keeps the link the Hebrew makes; Readable uses the plainer "kumsifu".

source.text: שִׁוִּ֬יתִי יְהוָ֣ה לְנֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִ֑יד כִּ֥י מִֽ֝ימִינִ֗י בַּל־אֶמּֽוֹט׃

records.literal_gloss: I have set YHWH before me continually; for [he is] at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

en.L: I have set {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} before me continually; for [{{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is] at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
en.B: I have placed {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in front of me at all times; since {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is there at my right hand, I will never stumble.
en.R: I always keep {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in mind. He is right beside me to help me, so nothing can shake me.

fr.L: J’ai placé {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} devant moi continuellement ; car [{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est] à ma droite, je ne serai pas ébranlé.
fr.B: J’ai mis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} devant moi en tout temps ; puisqu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est là, à ma droite, je ne tomberai jamais.
fr.R: Je pense toujours {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Il est juste à côté de moi pour m’aider, alors rien ne peut m’ébranler.

sw.L: Nimemweka {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mbele yangu siku zote; kwa kuwa [yu] upande wangu wa kuume, sitatikiswa.
sw.B: Nimemweka {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mbele yangu wakati wote; kwa kuwa yupo pale mkono wangu wa kuume, sitajikwaa kamwe.
sw.R: Daima ninamweka {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akilini mwangu. Yuko karibu nami kunisaidia, kwa hiyo hakuna kitu kitakachonitikisa.

es.L: He puesto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} delante de mí sin cesar; porque [{{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} está] a mi mano derecha, no vacilaré.
es.B: He colocado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} frente a mí en todo momento; como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} está allí, a mi derecha, nunca tropezaré.
es.R: Siempre tengo presente {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Él está a mi lado para ayudarme, así que nada puede hacerme caer.

decisions.choice: set the LORD before me: keep him always in view
decisions.reason: The psalmist lives with his attention fixed on the LORD.

decisions.choice: at my right hand: beside me as protector
decisions.reason: A defender stood at the right hand of the one he protected (109:31; 121:5).

decisions.choice: quoted by Peter in Acts 2
decisions.reason: Peter quotes verses 8-11 in his sermon at Pentecost (Acts 2:25-28) and applies them to the resurrection of Jesus; Paul quotes verse 10 in Acts 13:35.

source.text: לָכֵ֤ן׀שָׂמַ֣ח לִ֭בִּי וַיָּ֣גֶל כְּבוֹדִ֑י אַף־בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗י יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָבֶֽטַח׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore is glad my heart, and rejoices my glory; also my flesh will dwell in security.

en.L: Therefore my heart is glad and my glory rejoices; also my flesh will dwell in security.
en.B: That is why my heart is glad and my spirit celebrates; my body too will live in safety.
en.R: So I am happy and full of joy. I know my body will be safe.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi mon cœur est dans la joie et ma gloire exulte ; même ma chair habitera en sécurité.
fr.B: Voilà pourquoi mon cœur est dans la joie et mon esprit est en fête ; mon corps aussi vivra en sûreté.
fr.R: Alors je suis heureux et plein de joie. Je sais que mon corps sera en sécurité.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo moyo wangu unafurahi na utukufu wangu unashangilia; hata mwili wangu utakaa salama.
sw.B: Ndiyo maana moyo wangu unafurahi na roho yangu inashangilia; mwili wangu pia utaishi kwa usalama.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nina furaha na shangwe tele. Ninajua kwamba mwili wangu utakuwa salama.

es.L: Por tanto se alegra mi corazón y se goza mi gloria; también mi carne habitará segura.
es.B: Por eso mi corazón está alegre y mi espíritu hace fiesta; también mi cuerpo vivirá seguro.
es.R: Por eso estoy feliz y lleno de alegría. Sé que mi cuerpo estará a salvo.

decisions.choice: my glory: my inmost self
decisions.reason: "My glory" (kevodi) is a poetic word for a person's inner self, set beside "heart" (7:6; 30:13; Genesis 49:6). The ancient Greek translation has "my tongue", and Acts 2:26 quotes it so.

decisions.choice: my flesh will dwell in security: my body will be safe
decisions.reason: The body too will be safe in God's keeping. The ancient Greek translation reads "will rest in hope", the form quoted in Acts 2:26.

decisions.choice: my spirit
decisions.reason: Balanced says what "my glory" means here (m1); Literal keeps the Hebrew word.

source.text: כִּ֤י׀לֹא־תַעֲזֹ֣ב נַפְשִׁ֣י לִשְׁא֑וֹל לֹֽא־תִתֵּ֥ן חֲ֝סִידְךָ֗ לִרְא֥וֹת שָֽׁחַת׃

records.literal_gloss: For not you will abandon my soul to Sheol; not you will let your faithful one see [the] pit.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will not abandon my soul to Sheol; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will not let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful one see the pit.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will not give me up to Sheol, nor allow {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal one to see the pit.
en.R: You will not leave me in the place of the dead. You will not let the one who is faithful to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} go down to the grave.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’abandonneras pas mon âme au Shéol ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne laisseras pas {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} fidèle voir la fosse.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne me livreras pas au séjour des morts, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne permettras pas que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} fidèle voie la fosse.
fr.R: Tu ne me laisseras pas au séjour des morts. Tu ne laisseras pas celui qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}est fidèle descendre dans la tombe.

sw.L: Kwa maana hutaiacha nafsi yangu Kuzimu; hutamwacha mwaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} aone shimo.
sw.B: Kwa maana hutaniacha Kuzimu, wala hutamwacha mwaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} aone shimo.
sw.R: Hutaniacha Kuzimu. Hutamwacha yule aliye mwaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} ashuke kaburini.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no abandonarás mi alma al Seol; no permitirás que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fiel vea la fosa.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no me entregarás al lugar de los muertos, ni dejarás que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fiel vea la fosa.
es.R: Tú no me dejarás en el lugar de los muertos. No dejarás que el que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} es fiel baje a la tumba.

decisions.choice: Sheol: the place of the dead
decisions.reason: As in 6:6.

decisions.choice: the pit: the grave
decisions.reason: The word (shachat) means a pit, the grave. The ancient Greek translation took it from a verb meaning to ruin and has "decay", the reading Peter and Paul quote (Acts 2:27, 31; 13:35).

decisions.choice: your faithful one: singular
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is written in a form that could be read as plural, "your faithful ones"; the Hebrew notes and the ancient translations read it as singular, as here. The faithful one (chasid) is the one who is loyal to God (4:4).

decisions.choice: applied to the resurrection of Jesus
decisions.reason: Peter and Paul argue that David died and his body decayed, so these words point beyond him to Jesus, whom God raised (Acts 2:29-31; 13:35-37).

decisions.choice: me
decisions.reason: As in 3:3, "soul" means the whole person.

source.text: תּֽוֹדִיעֵנִי֮ אֹ֤רַח חַ֫יִּ֥ים שֹׂ֣בַע שְׂ֭מָחוֹת אֶת־פָּנֶ֑יךָ נְעִמ֖וֹת בִּימִינְךָ֣ נֶֽצַח׃

records.literal_gloss: You make known to me [the] path of life; fullness of joys [is] with your face, pleasant [things] at your right hand forever.

en.L: You will make known to me [the] path of life; fullness of joys [is] with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face, pleasant [things] at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand forever.
en.B: You teach me the road that leads to life; in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} presence there is joy in full, and at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand delights that never end.
en.R: You show me how to really live. Being near {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} fills me with joy. At {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} side there are good things that last forever.

fr.L: Tu me feras connaître [le] sentier de la vie ; plénitude de joies [est] avec {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face, délices à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} droite pour toujours.
fr.B: Tu m’apprends la route qui mène à la vie ; auprès de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, la joie est complète, et à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} droite il y a des délices sans fin.
fr.R: Tu me montres comment vivre vraiment. Être près de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} me remplit de joie. À {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} côtés, il y a de bonnes choses qui durent toujours.

sw.L: Utanionyesha njia ya uzima; wingi wa shangwe [uko] pamoja na uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, mambo matamu katika mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume daima.
sw.B: Unanifundisha barabara inayoelekea uzimani; mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kuna furaha kamili, na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume kuna raha zisizokwisha.
sw.R: Unanionyesha jinsi ya kuishi kweli. Kuwa karibu {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} kunanijaza furaha. Kando {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kuna mambo mema yanayodumu milele.

es.L: Tú me darás a conocer [la] senda de la vida; plenitud de gozos [hay] ante {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro, cosas agradables a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano derecha para siempre.
es.B: Tú me enseñas el camino que lleva a la vida; en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} presencia hay alegría completa, y a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} derecha, deleites que nunca terminan.
es.R: Tú me enseñas a vivir de verdad. Estar cerca de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} me llena de alegría. A {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lado hay cosas buenas que duran para siempre.

decisions.choice: the path of life: the way that leads to life
decisions.reason: The path of life is the way of living that God shows, which leads away from death (Proverbs 15:24); after verse 10 it is life that death does not end.

decisions.choice: with your face: in your presence
decisions.reason: To be before someone's face is to be in their presence (11:7).

decisions.choice: at your right hand: the place of favor
decisions.reason: The right hand is the place of honor and blessing beside a king (110:1).

decisions.choice: quoted in Acts 2:28
decisions.reason: See verse 8.
